title: qgb gate report (volatile, permissive)
description: Schema for gate.json under artifacts/.../runs/<timestamp>/. Same required fields as curated, but additionalProperties allowed for future expansion.

mode.description: Phase 2 Step 2.4: present (value 'check') only on gates produced by 'qgb check'. Official 'qgb run' gates omit this field (absence = official). When mode=check, paths.curated_latest_dir must be absent (see allOf).

timestamp_utc.description: Compact UTC timestamp (wall-clock truth, seconds precision): YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ. Same instant as timestamp_rfc3339. paths.run_dir uses <timestamp_utc>-<run_id> so collisions are absorbed by run_id, not by walking timestamps forward.

run_id.description: Per-second monotonic counter ('r' + 4 hex digits, r0001..rffff) embedded in paths.run_dir. r0000 is reserved.

run_dir.description: Trailing segment shape: <timestamp_utc>-<run_id> with run_id != r0000.

result.description: Step 2.4 補修 A3: 'waived' was added in Step 7 to the curated schema but this volatile schema had drifted (kept ['passed','failed']). A waived stage appears in every gate the runner writes — volatile runs/, curated latest/, and Step 2.4 check rehearsals (which exist ONLY in the volatile tree) — so the volatile schema must accept it too.

reason.description: Step 3.1c: machine-readable reason for a non-passing command stage. Optional — present only when qgb.core.command had to terminate the process tree (timeout or 16 MiB per-stream execution cap). Absent for natural exits regardless of exit_code. Enum values are part of the gate.json contract; new codes require a schema migration.

runner_warning.description: Step 3.1b-3 / 3.1c: free-text record of degraded kill paths (e.g. Windows Job Object setup failed → grandchildren may leak). Optional — when present, indicates the gate's audit trail has a known weakness on this stage that no machine could compensate for. Search for non-null runner_warning in basis audits to find compromised stages.

allOf.description: Official run gate (mode absent): paths.curated_latest_dir is required (Phase 1 invariant, byte-compatible with pre-mode gates).
Check rehearsal gate (mode=check, Phase 2 Step 2.4): paths.curated_latest_dir must be ABSENT.

ALLOW: failed_stage must be empty, decision.result must be ALLOW, every non-waived stage must have result=passed, and at least one passed stage must exist. Same semantic constraints as the curated schema (Step 2.4 補修 A3 で waived 対応の乖離を解消); only the additionalProperties policy differs.

DENY: decision.result must be DENY. Either a stage actually failed (failed_stage non-empty, at least one stage.result=failed) OR every adopted stage is waived (failed_stage empty, no stages.result=failed) — Step 7's 'no judgement material' branch, mirrored from the curated schema (Step 2.4 補修 A3).

oneOf.description: All-waived DENY (Step 7): no judgement material. failed_stage is empty and no stage has result=failed.
